SELECT
  "DateTime(UTC)" AS "time",

  "InAreaDisplayName" AS "metric", 

  "ForecastTransferCapacity[MW]" AS "value"
FROM
  entsoe_fms."ForecastedTransferCapacities"
WHERE
  "DateTime(UTC)" BETWEEN to_timestamp($__from / 1000) AND to_timestamp($__to / 1000)
  AND
  "OutAreaDisplayName" = '$Country'
ORDER BY
  "time" ASC;

SELECT
  "DateTime(UTC)" AS "time",

  "OutAreaDisplayName" AS "metric", 

  "ForecastTransferCapacity[MW]" AS "value"
FROM
  entsoe_fms."ForecastedTransferCapacities"
WHERE
  "DateTime(UTC)" BETWEEN to_timestamp($__from / 1000) AND to_timestamp($__to / 1000)
  AND
  "InAreaDisplayName" = '$Country'
ORDER BY
  "time" ASC;

SELECT
  $__timeGroupAlias(my_time, $__interval),
  'Day-Ahead (60m)' AS "metric",
  avg("Price[Currency/MWh]") AS "Day-Ahead Hourly"
FROM (
  SELECT
    "DateTime(UTC)" AS my_time,
    "Price[Currency/MWh]"
  FROM
    entsoe_fms."EnergyPrices"
  WHERE
    "DateTime(UTC)" BETWEEN to_timestamp($__from / 1000) AND to_timestamp($__to / 1000) AND
    "AreaDisplayName" = '$Country' AND
    "AreaTypeCode" = 'BZN' AND
    (TRIM(COALESCE("Sequence", '')) = '' OR "Sequence" = '1') 
) AS sub
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1 ASC;

SELECT
  $__timeGroupAlias(my_time, $__interval),
  'Day-Ahead (15m)' AS "metric",
  avg("Price[Currency/MWh]") AS "Day-Ahead Quarter-hourly"
FROM (
  SELECT
    "DateTime(UTC)" AS my_time,
    "Price[Currency/MWh]"
  FROM
    entsoe_fms."EnergyPrices"
  WHERE
    "DateTime(UTC)" BETWEEN to_timestamp($__from / 1000) AND to_timestamp($__to / 1000) AND
    "AreaDisplayName" = '$Country' AND
    "AreaTypeCode" = 'BZN' AND
    "Sequence" = '2'
) AS sub
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1 ASC;

SELECT
  $__timeGroupAlias(my_time, $__interval),

) AS sub
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1 ASC;

SELECT

  "ProductionType" AS metric,
  avg("ActualGenerationOutput[MW]") AS "Generation"
FROM
  "entsoe_fms"."AggregatedGenerationPerType"
WHERE
  "DateTime(UTC)" >= to_timestamp($__from / 1000.0)
  AND
  "DateTime(UTC)" <= to_timestamp($__to / 1000.0)
  AND "AreaDisplayName" = '$Country'

  "time", "ProductionType"

SELECT
    make_date("Year"::int, 1, 1) AS "time",
    "ProductionType",
    SUM("AggregatedInstalledCapacity[MW]") AS " "
FROM
  entsoe_fms."InstalledGenerationCapacityAggregated"
WHERE
  "AreaDisplayName" = '$Country'
  AND
  "AreaTypeCode" = '$Area_Type'
GROUP BY "time", "ProductionType"
ORDER BY
  "time";

SELECT
  0 AS "time",
  AVG(lat) AS lat,
  AVG(lon) AS lon,
  fuel_type AS "energy_source",
  country,
  SUM(capacity) AS "capacity",
  name
FROM entsoe_fms.powersystemdata
WHERE
  (date_out IS NULL OR date_out >= EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE)) AND
  fuel_type IN (
    'Nuclear',     
    'Hard Coal',   
    'Lignite',     
    'Natural Gas',  
    'Oil',         
    'Waste',       
    'Hydro',       
    'Other'
  )
GROUP BY 
  name, 
  fuel_type, 
  country, 
  "time"
HAVING 
  SUM(capacity) >= 50  
ORDER BY 
  "capacity" DESC

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  0 AS "time",
  AVG(lat) AS lat,
  AVG(lon) AS lon,
  fuel_type AS "energy_source",
  country,
  SUM(capacity) AS "capacity",
  
  CASE 
      WHEN name IS NULL OR name = '' OR name = 'Nan' 
      THEN country || '_' || fuel_type || '_Nr_' || source_id::text
      ELSE name 
  END AS name

FROM entsoe_fms.powersystemdata
WHERE
  (date_out IS NULL OR date_out >= EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE)) AND
  fuel_type Not IN (
    'Nuclear',     
    'Hard Coal',   
    'Lignite',     
    'Natural Gas',  
    'Oil',         
    'Waste',       
    'Hydro',       
    'Other'
  )
GROUP BY 
  CASE 
      WHEN name IS NULL OR name = '' OR name = 'Nan' 
      THEN country || '_' || fuel_type || '_Nr_' || source_id::text
      ELSE name 
  END,
  fuel_type, 
  country, 
  "time"
HAVING 
  SUM(capacity) >= 50  
ORDER BY 
  "capacity" DESC

    ('Norway (NO)', 'Norway'), ('NO1', 'Norway'), ('NO2', 'Norway'), 
    ('NO3', 'Norway'), ('NO4', 'Norway'), ('NO5', 'Norway'),
    ('Poland (PL)', 'Poland'),
    ('Portugal (PT)', 'Portugal'),
    ('Romania (RO)', 'Romania'),
    ('Serbia (RS)', 'Serbia'),
    ('Slovakia (SK)', 'Slovakia'),

    ('Spain (ES)', 'Spain'),
    ('Sweden (SE)', 'Sweden'), ('SE1', 'Sweden'), ('SE2', 'Sweden'), 
    ('SE3', 'Sweden'), ('SE4', 'Sweden'),

    ('United Kingdom (UK)', 'United Kingdom'),
    ('Ukraine (UA)', 'Ukraine')
)

SELECT
  0 AS "time", 
  AVG(t.lat) AS lat,
  AVG(t.lon) AS lon,
  t.fuel_type AS "energy_source",
  t.country,
  SUM(t.capacity) AS "capacity",
  CASE 
      WHEN t.name IS NULL OR t.name = '' OR t.name = 'nan' 
      THEN t.country || '_' || t.fuel_type || '_Nr_' || t.source_id::text
      ELSE t.name 
  END AS name

FROM entsoe_fms.powersystemdata t
WHERE
  t.country IN (
      SELECT DISTINCT m.db_name 
      FROM val_map m
      WHERE m.grafana_label IN (${Country:sqlstring}) 
  )
  AND (t.date_out IS NULL OR t.date_out >= EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE))

GROUP BY 
  CASE 
      WHEN t.name IS NULL OR t.name = '' OR t.name = 'nan' 
      THEN t.country || '_' || t.fuel_type || '_Nr_' || t.source_id::text
      ELSE t.name 
  END,
  t.fuel_type, 
  t.country

panels.title: Power Plant Distributed in each County

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  0 AS "time",
  AVG(lat) AS lat,                
  AVG(lon) AS lon,
  country,
  fuel_type AS "energy_source",
  SUM(plant_capacity) AS "capacity", 
  'Small ' || fuel_type || ' (<50MW)' AS name 
FROM (
    
    SELECT 
        country,
        fuel_type,
        AVG(lat) as lat,
        AVG(lon) as lon,
        SUM(capacity) as plant_capacity
    FROM entsoe_fms.powersystemdata
    WHERE (date_out IS NULL OR date_out >= EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE))
    GROUP BY name, country, fuel_type
    HAVING SUM(capacity) < 50
) AS small_plants
GROUP BY 
  country, 
  fuel_type,
  "time"

SELECT
  0 AS "time",
  lat,
  lon,
  name,
  country_name,
  status_color,
  location_tag,
  display_mode,
  asset_count,
  installed_capacity_mw,
  available_capacity_mw,
  unavailable_capacity_mw,
  availability_ratio,
  active_outage_count,
  reason
FROM entsoe_availability_map.v_availability_map_points_next_24h
WHERE snapshot_utc = date_trunc('hour', now()) + (${Availability_Hour_Offset} || ' hour')::interval
  AND layer = '$Availability_Layer'
ORDER BY unavailable_capacity_mw DESC NULLS LAST, asset_count DESC;
